title: Master 3-Chord Songs with A, D, E: Capo, Play-Alongs, and Beginner Song List
summary: This beginner-focused guitar lesson centers on using just three chords—A major, D major, and E major—to play a wide range of songs. The instructor discusses practical strategies for practicing with a limited palette, including using a capo to align with original recordings, and relies on play-alongs from a dedicated app or website. He catalogs example songs that fit the A-D-E framework (and some that use only A and D), highlights Three Little Birds as a particularly suitable 3-chord tune, and emphasizes choosing material you love to maintain motivation. The video also directs learners to a Spotify playlist and a website page with song lists and additional resources, and it promotes integrating drum/bass/m melody tracks to focus on chord changes and strumming practice.
